cam_no_image: No camera image (you can still start the print).
tip_process: Print profile (layer height and speed). Thicker layers (e.g. 0.28 mm) print faster, thinner layers (e.g. 0.12 mm) give finer detail.
tip_filament: Material profile (nozzle/bed temps, cooling, flow). Automatically matched to the selected Spoolman slot.
tip_slot: MMU slot (T0–T3) with an assigned Spoolman spool. Defaults to the cheapest filament per gram.
tip_copies: Number of copies of this model. If copies do not fit on one plate, the slicer splits them across multiple plates.
tip_auto_orient: Automatically rotates the model for the largest flat base and minimal supports.
tip_auto_arrange: Automatically arranges objects on the build plate with safe spacing (always on for more than 1 copy).
tip_enable_support: Tree supports — temporary branches holding up overhangs. Easy to remove after printing.
tip_brim_mode: Brim — thin collar around the first layer improving bed adhesion for tall or narrow models. Auto mode adds it only when needed.
